limitations: Paper full text not accessible (not in Europe PMC, not open access); paper methods and supplement not read, only PRIDE text and deposited files
Channel 126 as common channel is inferred: msf labels it Sample_Type_Mix 'Control' with an unnamed time option
Common-channel source granularity (one per variant/arm/replicate tube) and whether the pool is shared across the two arms are not stated
WT Sample BRep2 T7 has no deposited .msf; its channel map is assumed equal to T1-T6 of the same tube; the Delta Sample BRep3 T7 .msf has no deposited RAW
Channel 131 lacks the BioRep factor in the msf; replicate taken from the file name
Mixed samples carry a single organism (SARS-CoV-2) although they also contain mouse antibody
Modifications are the union over search rounds; the full msf workflow (all nodes) was not read, only the first 700 kB; msf tolerance 20 ppm / 0.5 Da conflicts with PRIDE 10 ppm / 0.1 Da
PRIDE protocol says RBD Alpha while file names and paper title say wild type; written as wild type

Acquisition dates not annotated; Lys-C is encoded as a second cleavage agent column (PRIDE protocol: 2% LysC 1 h, then methylated trypsin 10 h); PNGaseF deglycosylation is not captured. RBD variant: file names and the PRIDE project description say wild type, while the PRIDE sample protocol, Experimental_setup.docx and the abstract say Alpha; annotated as `wild type` (no source cites a lineage such as B.1.1.7)
Validator error 'study sample not found in pride' is a cache artifact (PRIDE:0001013 valid live); reconcile cleavage_agent_unsupported flags methylated trypsin wording (false positive)
